report:
Skin, right thigh, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block. A second punch biopsy of skin measuring 0.3 x 0.3 x 0.3 cm is received in Michel's medium for direct immunofluorescence.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. There is a subepidermal blister containing eosinophils. The dermis shows a mild superficial perivascular infiltrate of lymphocytes and eosinophils, with papillary dermal oedema. Direct immunofluorescence studies show linear deposition of IgG and C3 along the basement membrane zone; IgA, IgM, C1q and fibrinogen are negative. The overall features are those of bullous pemphigoid. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, right thigh, punch biopsy - BULLOUS PEMPHIGOID
